title: Percentages, Fractions and Approximations
goal: State percentages, fractions and cautious approximations accurately in formal Spanish reports.

items: I can introduce percentages with *el* and keep agreement accurate with partitive figures.
I can express approximate figures with *en torno a*, *alrededor de*, *aproximadamente* and *rondar*.
I can present fractions such as *la mitad* and *un tercio* in demographic summaries.
